onscreen_lines.desc: Location: Demolition Trade: 5 790- Moline Demolition Specification The contractor shall apply for, pay for, obtain and forward copies of required permits to the agency: All permits as required by City of Moline Building Department. Work to comply with all applicable Moline Codes and Ordinances.Contractor responsible for knowledge of and adherence to the above codes and ordinances. Demolish and dispose of structure(s) cited in bid documents adhering to Moline Ordinances Section 3303 " Demolition, and Sections 8-7400 thru 8-7403 pertaining to" Filling and Grading Requirements" and well as all other applicable City, State, or Federal regulations. Additionally, the concrete foundation walls, footings, and flooring to be broken and hauled. No material from the house to be left on site or used for fill. ASBESTOS: This property is considered a "Regulate friable asbestos-containing building material (RACM), meaning any material containing more than one percent asbestos which is in or on interior structural members or any other parts of structural members. Due to extensive fire damage to property and significant structural damage the City of Moline has deemed the property at 1627 2 Street, Moline, unsafe to enter. Sections of the house are full of debris and sections of the house the floors have collapsed. The structure should be considered unsafe and treated as Regulated Asbestos Containing Material (RACM). The structure is a two story house with aluminum siding and shingle roof. Follow EPA 40 CFR 763 sub Asbestos Removal Plan. After collapsing the structure, place material into leak proof wrapping. Keep site adequately wet during demolition to keep dust down. Whenever possible, use a plastic liner in the bottom of the bed of the dump truck to minimize the leakage of containment from the dump truck. If the asbestos containing material has been further broken up during the loading process, wet it down again after loading into dump truck. Cover dump truck with a tarp, sealing it so that debris and dust can not be released during transport. Apply warning sign, "Warning:Asbestos Hazard. Stay Away". Truck the debris to a landfill allowed to receive asbestos. Maintain your waste shipment records. Contractor responsible for any icing on sidewalk and street adjacent to site. Contain water and salt as needed. When permit is taken out check also with City of Moline Environmental Manager regarding any erosion control measures or drainage permit that the particular location may require. Check with City to be sure all disconnects have been completed before beginning demolition. Demolition to include: 22'x38' fire damaged two-story structure and foundation; front and rear concrete steps; sidewalk running adjacent to structure and to right of way; 20' x 20' shed (Side C) rear corner of lot.
